latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Maker GPT Free (version 1.0.0).
- Create ready-to-share videos (up to 1080p MP4) from user-uploaded video clips or images using AI prompts.
- Supports MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG files up to 500MB.
- Free, cloud-based rendering with automatic session and token management; no installation required.
- Users can check status, credits, or export videos with simple commands.
- Designed for quick, AI-assisted video creation for content creators and marketers.
